# THE SHIPPED TRANSPORT FOLD — `<wire key> <layer it was composed over, or ->`, one row per wire, in
# the order the boot seal builds and registers them. Read by root/tests/registry.rs
# (`the_fold_builds_bottom_up_in_composes_over_order`); a build that does not link a wire has no
# row for it and the remaining rows keep this order. A wire added, dropped or re-layered has to say
# so here.
